scope: Exploratory reused val users; fixed encoders and folds, one fixed sketch. Same-width recipe comparison; incremental slot comparisons retain the compressed or full mean but add reader capacity. No endpoint gate or automatic FM continuation.

features.slot_basis: Sylvester Hadamard64; no slot permutation; row0 mean is implicit
features.slot_weight_scale: each coefficient +/-1/64, same row norm as mean weights
features.channel_basis: float64 Gaussian384x48 reduced QR, positive diagonal R; cast float32
features.residual_extraction: FP32: center z by its slot mean, apply slot weights then shared channel projection
features.residual_storage: float32 raw contrasts, shape(window,patch,336); no normalization in extraction
features.normalization: M is historical FP32 torch LayerNorm(mean_FP16); residuals divided by sqrt(var_feature(mean_FP16_FP32)+eps); no separate residual LayerNorm, PCA or scaler
features.M48_control: normalized mean projected to the same 48 channels; no residual modes
features.S384_order: mean@channel_projection, residual slot modes in frozen row order
features.S720_order: full normalized mean, residual slot modes in frozen row order

recipe.target_support: center target mask only; neighboring target masks never define input validity
recipe.cv: alternating sorted train users, two folds; masked pooled standardized SSE; E3 alpha grid/extension
recipe.fit: float64 sufficient statistics; unpenalized intercept; refit all 40 train users
recipe.dynamic_selection: original full-window cached pose_var >= frozen median
recipe.primary: S384 minus M384 for B/R3c and difference of these contrasts, same feature width; not residual-only attribution
recipe.compressed_mean_control: S384 minus M48 for B/R3c and difference of these contrasts, adding residuals to the same compressed mean
recipe.secondary: S720 minus M384 for B/R3c and difference of these contrasts; larger reader preserving full mean
recipe.scope: Only seven fixed slot contrasts projected to 48 channels; a negative result does not exclude other slot information.
